{{Youmay|the lubricant|[[Grease (individual)|Grease]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]}}
{{Quote|But then again, I've never seen anything a Wookiee couldn't build or fix, given enough grease and transmission wire.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] comments on the abilities of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]]|<ref name="SWGB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>}}
'''Grease''' was a lubricant,<ref name="MS2">''[[MedStar II: Jedi Healer]]''</ref><ref name="SotME">''[[Splinter of the Mind's Eye]]''</ref><ref name="TNRST">"''[[Simple Tricks]]''", ''[[Tales from the New Republic]]''</ref> used in the manufacture and upkeep of objects.<ref name="JASE1">''[[Jedi Apprentice Special Edition: Deceptions]]''</ref>

[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]] were described by [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] to be able to construct and repair anything, provided they possessed enough grease and [[transmission wire]].<ref name="SWGB" />

[[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] once called his counterpart [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] an overweight glob of grease.<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Used as a verb, "grease" was also commonly used as a euphemism for destruction.<ref name="DF1">''[[Dark Forces: Soldier for the Empire]]''</ref>
